physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: Captured evaluation 1 at utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0, repair_margin=0 with both RTL actions reports cell_area_um2=160081 versus baseline 161954 (about 1.16% lower), setup_slack_ns=-0.0262439 versus +0.19292, hold_slack_ns=+0.0945523, and zero max_slew/max_cap/max_fanout violations. It failed physical_qualified and rank_eligible with failure_classes=[physical_execution,timing]; energy_j and estimated_power_w are empty and no postprocessing commands ran. Its Q is therefore unavailable, not improved. The earlier passing review established proposal admissibility only. Choose the unseen combination utilization=30 with both actions retained, changing one physical parameter to test additional placement room after the timing failure. Lower utilization may ease congestion and placement competition but can lengthen wires, enlarge the clock network, and increase buffering and workload energy; no critical-path evidence establishes the failure cause or guarantees recovery. Keep density=0.55 and timing-oriented abc_area=0; zero electrical violations provide no evidence to increase repair_margin above 0. Retain proved request-gated multiplier operand isolation and exact signed 18-bit reduction with 32-bit sign extension and unchanged cycle contract. Their combined area result motivates retaining them, while isolation overhead and physical variability remain risks. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(Ew/Ebaseline_w), with baseline DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3 energies 2.293945631906608e-7, 1.7792685987008622e-6, 1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Larger empty floorplan and a timing estimate do not establish improvement. Protected evaluation must report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, per-workload energy_j and estimated_power_w, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, and physical/postprocess/total costs. Require the frozen correctness, timing, electrical and annotation checks at 10526 ps before ranking; assess Q against 1.0 and 0.98 only with qualified measurements. Energy scope remains Liberty estimates using zero-delay post-route activity and extracted SPEF, with no SDF-glitch or silicon-power claim. Retain evaluation 1 and its 3156.5922689560684 s total cost, including 3156.5922685480327 s physical time; its elapsed_search_seconds=3321.2583581329673 includes EDA and does not establish remaining agent budget. One of three candidate evaluations is captured; propose only this next candidate within the unchanged shared 1200 s agent budget, with EDA wait separate. Baseline Q=1 remains the best qualified result pending protected evaluation; this proposal makes no measured improvement claim.
